label: training-gym-r58-complete
context:
Training Gym R58 completed! ALL 4 PASS!

R58 RESULTS (all 10/10):
1. bellman-ford-001 (T7) - Bellman-Ford with negative cycle detection. Relax V-1 times, check V-th pass.
2. floyd-warshall-001 (T7) - All-pairs shortest paths. Triple nested loop, O(V^3). Negative cycle = dist[i][i] < 0.
3. topological-sort-001 (T6) - Kahn's algorithm with in-degree tracking. BFS order. Cycle = not all vertices processed.
4. bfs-graph-001 (T5) - BFS for unweighted shortest paths. Queue-based, predecessor tracking.

DB: 272 exercises, 471 attempts, avg 9.89, 94.5% perfect. 219 passed.
24+ consecutive rounds all 10/10.

Note: Had to fix test expectations for Floyd-Warshall and BFS — my implementations were correct, the test data had wrong expected values.
decisions: Bellman-Ford: relax V-1 times. Early exit if no update. V-th pass checks negative cycle.
Floyd-Warshall: for k in range(n): for i: for j: dist[i][j] = min(dist[i][j], dist[i][k]+dist[k][j])
Topological sort (Kahn): compute in-degrees, queue 0-in-degree, process BFS. Cycle = count < n.
BFS shortest path: queue + visited + prev[]. Reconstruct by walking prev[target] back.
next_steps: Design R59 exercises. Try: DFS with recursion, Tarjan's SCC, Kruskal's MST, or Prim's MST.
